{{Quote|We are always having our challenges, but we will prevail. Of that, I have no doubt.|Captain Quellium, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RttR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Report to the Rebels|Talus}}</ref>}}
'''Vayde Quellium''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] on [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|There is an organization of mercenaries here on Talus that is giving me fits. They are called the Nightstrike Soldier Hegemony. Recently, they confiscated a shipment of medical supplies that would go a long way in helping the Alliance's efforts here.|Captain Quellium, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RI" />}}
Vayde Quellium was a Rebel Alliance [[Officer/Legends|officer]] during the Galactic Civil War between the Rebellion and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the young Bothan had achieved the rank of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and was stationed in the city of [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]] on Talus.<ref name="SWG:RI" /> His office was located in the building of the [[Wideband Temp Agency]], a front company for Rebel recruiters.<ref name="SWG:CoA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Crisis of Allegiance|Talus}}</ref>

By the time following the Battle of Yavin, Captain Quellium was working with [[Trezya Nenei]], a representative of the [[Aggregate Civil Liberties Organization]], an anti-Imperial organization on Talus.<ref name="SWG:RI" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the A.C.L.O. was seeking to join the Rebel Alliance on a permanent basis. In the meanwhile, both the A.C.L.O. and the Rebels were in conflict with the [[Nightstrike Soldier Hegemony]], a Talusian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] organization affiliated with the Empire. At some point, N.S.H. troops shut down an A.C.L.O. clinic and imprisoned the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] medical officer [[Syirlabradawk]]. They also confiscated a shipment of medical supplies which were intended for the Alliance forces on Talus. Captain Quellium and Trezya Nenei therefore sent a spacer to raid the [[N.S.H. base]].<ref name="SWG:RI" /> The spacer was recommended by [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] officer [[Dathnaeya Loessin]] who wanted to determine what kind of people the Rebellion and the Empire had chosen to work with.<ref name="SWG:CoA" /> The spacer assaulted the N.S.H. base and eventually managed to retrieve the medical shipment and rescue the medical officer, killing many N.S.H. enforcers in the process.<ref name="SWG:RI" /><ref name="SWG:MO">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Medical Officer|Talus}}</ref> Vayde Quellium was very grateful and tried to recruit the spacer in the Rebellion.<ref name="SWG:RttR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vayde Quellium appeared as a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RI" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Vayde Quellium was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Crisis of Allegiance|Crisis of Allegiance]]" arc with the release of "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 2|Chapter 2: The Talus Incident]]," on [[August 1]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 2: The Talus Incident Publish Notes, August 1st">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=58871|text="Chapter 2: The Talus Incident" Publish Notes, August 1st}}</ref>
